description: This file defines the TabStop class, which models a tab stop within a paragraph in a document. It includes properties for position, alignment, and leader character, along with methods for cloning and serialization.

classes.name: TabStop
classes.description: Represents a tab stop within a paragraph, including its position, alignment, and leader character.

methods.name: TabStop()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing tab stop values.

methods.name: Clone()
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the TabStop instance.

properties.name: Position
properties.description: Gets or sets the position of the tab stop.

properties.name: Alignment
properties.description: Gets or sets the alignment of the tab stop.

properties.name: Leader
properties.description: Gets or sets the leader character for the tab stop.

properties.name: AddTab
properties.description: Indicates whether the tab is added ('+=') or removed ('-=') in DDL serialization.

properties.name: Values
properties.description: Provides access to internal nullable values for properties.

inner_classes.name: TabStopValues
inner_classes.description: Contains internal nullable properties for the TabStop instance.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Converts the TabStop to its DDL representation using a serializer.
